subject: Nimbus Analytics — Annual Prepay Sweep & Country Ledger Ownership
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@nimbus-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Mar 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Nimbus — annual prepay sweep plan / ledger ownership (draft)

Hi all,

Attaching the draft sweep plan for Nimbus' annual prepay (Q2 start). Key asks:
- Confirm which internal team will own the country-ledger mapping for invoiced drawdowns (we need an owner per country to accept VAT evidence and remit).
- Confirmation from Nimbus on whether they can send per-country invoices (e.g., UK + DE separate) or will provide a single consolidated invoice + tax breakdown.
- Finalize drawdown windows: proposed monthly 1st-of-month sweep starting 2028-04-01 (see attached).

Attachments: 2028Q1_prepay_sweep_plan.xlsx, country_vat_routing.pdf

Naomi — can you review VAT routing and call out any countries where evidence will be a blocker?
Ben — can finance ops own the ledger and do remittance reconciliation?
Laura — can you confirm ops timeline to enable the sweep?
Elena — request: include your AP contact for remittance and PO ref format.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Rev Ops (Americas)
Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@nimbus-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Nimbus — annual prepay sweep plan / ledger ownership (draft)

Thanks Irene — quick read. Two items I flagged in the attached PDF:
1) Germany: we need Nimbus' VAT registration certificate + proof of local tax agent; otherwise our tax team will withhold VAT gross-up until evidence is provided.
2) Italy: invoice sequence must include local tax ids for NIC validation, otherwise downstream posting fails.

Ben — for countries where we cannot accept a single consolidated invoice (DE, IT), do we want to accept split invoices and route to separate ledger codes? If so, we need a mapping table (country -> ledger code) from Finance.

Elena — can you confirm whether Nimbus can split invoices by legal entity/country? If not, we need to plan a reconciliation step and extended hold period.

Naomi
Senior Tax Counsel
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Nimbus — annual prepay sweep plan / ledger ownership (draft)

Irene / Naomi — Finance Ops can take lead on ledger ownership. Proposed approach:
- Assign a primary ledger owner (Ben Carter) and regional owners for exceptions.
- Create a small mapping table: country|legal_entity|ledger_code|required_evidence. I'll attach the initial mapping and the payment instructions we will send to Nimbus.

Notes:
- We can accept split invoices for DE and IT if Nimbus can provide separate legal entity invoices. If they cannot, we will accept a consolidated invoice but will require a monthly VAT breakdown to be attached for posting.
- For hold windows: recommend 7 business day post-invoice review before sweep to allow tax verification.

Attachment: payment_instructions_Nimbus.zip (contains wire details + remittance template)

Ben Carter
Director, Finance Ops
Redwood Inference

Hi everyone — thanks for the note and the plan. A few quick answers: 
- We can issue per-country invoices for most countries (including DE, IT), but we need to confirm for BR and MX (pen-testing legal there). I'll follow up with AP today.
- Attached is our invoice template and the AP contact for remittance. We prefer payment by ACH / SEPA where possible; wire for other regions.
- PO reference: please use the Redwood Deal ID NBX-2028-0071 on all invoices.

Attachments: Nimbus_invoice_template.xlsx

Best,

Nimbus Analytics

Good catch on the country exceptions. A couple of operational confirmations from my side: 
- Ops can enable the automated sweep starting 2028-04-01 provided Finance publishes the final country->ledger mapping by 2028-03-20.
- The 7 business day review window looks fine; we'll schedule the sweep job to run on the 1st of each month at 02:00 UTC and hold for the review cutoff at 09:00 UTC.
- For consolidated invoices with VAT breakdown attached, we will require a structured CSV (columns: invoice_number, country, tax_amount, net_amount) to ingest automatically.

Ben — can you confirm you will publish the mapping and the CSV schema?

Laura Bennett
Billing & Collections Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Nimbus — annual prepay sweep plan / ledger ownership (final)

Thanks everyone — summary and next steps:
- Ledger ownership: Ben Carter will be primary owner. Ben to circulate final country->ledger mapping CSV by 2028-03-18. (Action: Ben)
- VAT evidence: Nimbus to provide DE VAT registration and IT tax ids where applicable. (Action: Elena / payments@nimbus-analytics.com)
- Invoice format: Nimbus will attempt per-country invoices; if consolidated, they will attach the structured CSV (invoice_number,country,tax_amount,net_amount) to each monthly invoice. (Action: Elena)
- Sweep timing: Ops to schedule automated sweep on the 1st of each month at 02:00 UTC with a 7 business day review hold. Live start: 2028-04-01 pending mapping. (Action: Laura)
- PO / remittance: Use Deal ID NBX-2028-0071 as PO reference; Ben's payment instructions accepted (see payment_instructions_Nimbus.zip). (Action: Elena)

I'll mark this thread as the canonical sweep plan for Nimbus. If there are no objections, Ben — please send the mapping by EOD 2028-03-18 so Laura can lock the job schedule.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Head of Rev Ops (Americas)
Redwood Inference
